title: Help, changelog, beta, status và support

scope_items.title: Articles unreviewed for >90 days flagged stale, low-rating (<60% helpful) rewrite queue, reviewer notes & timestamp logged in version history, contextual help mapped by module M01-M23

Beta program enrollment restricted to paid tiers (Starter+; Free rejected), 50 bonus credits awarded exactly once per workspace, re-enrollment activates feature flags with 0 bonus credits, graduation criteria (stability >= 14d, >=80% positive feedback, 0 bugs)

8 monitored status components (§5.1), incident severity SLAs (P0 15m/30m/48h post-mortem, P1 30m/1h/5d, P2 4h/end-of-day), public status endpoint guarantees subscriber privacy (never exposes contact details, only aggregate counts, management via secret privacy token), notification dispatch without cross-subscriber leakage

Support SLAs per legal_compliance.md §7.2 (Free 48h/120h, Starter 24h/72h, Pro 8h/24h, Business 2h/8h, Enterprise 1h/4h), SLA breach detection emitting support.sla_breached, strict isolation filtering internal notes from workspace callers
In-app announcements with session frequency limiting (max 1 per session), persistent dismissal, and formatted changelog
